choices.4: The system temperatures do not meet the burner start requirements. The burner is waiting for the temperature to meet the start conditions
choices.10: external gasvalve valve is opened, when this option is connectedto the system. External option boards must be connected to drive the valve
choices.11: Before the burner starts the fan goes to an increased rpm before the flue gas valve is opened.
choices.12: Opening of the flue gas valve
choices.13: Increase the fan speed to prepurge RPM
choices.14: Wait a time defined by a parameter, for the release input to close before the burner can start
choices.15: Send a burner start command to the safety core
choices.17: Start the ignitor before the gas valve is opened
choices.19: Check the pressence of the flame directly after the ignition
choices.20: Purge the heat exchanger after a failed ignition
choices.21: Wait for the burner to be active.
choices.22: Waiting for Boiler Room Ventilation Fan to start
choices.30: The boiler is burning for the requested setpoint
choices.31: The boiler is burning for a reduced internal setpoint due to temperature limitations
choices.32: The boiler is burning on the requested power, the boiler is burning on power control
choices.33: the heat exchanger temperature is rising faster than gradient level 1, the modulation is stopped
choices.34: the heat exchanger temperature is rising faster than gradient level 2, the modulation is set to low load
choices.35: the heat exchanger temperature is rising faster than gradient level 1, the boiler is in blocking
choices.36: The ionization signal is too low the burner power is increased to increase the ionization signal. Prevent the burner to switch off
choices.37: Stabilization time, during this time the temperatures should stabilize. The temperature protections are swichted off
choices.38: To prevent noise due to a cold burner the burner runs at start load for 30 seconds
choices.39: Central heating was interruppted by Dhw and now resumes at the power level where it was running on
choices.40: Remove the burner demand from the safety core
choices.41: Purge the heat exchanger after a burner demand
choices.43: Set the fan speed to close the flue gas valve
choices.45: The flue gas temperature is to high, parameter setting, the burner power is decreased to lower the flue gas temperature
choices.46: The auto filling is filling the installation, the installation was empty.
choices.47: The auto filling is topping up the installation. The water pressure in the installation was low.
choices.48: The flow temperature set point is reduced to protect the heat exchanger against thermal stress when the maximum set point has been set higher than the maximum value (parHeReducedFlowTempMaxAtMaxDt)
choices.49: Gas valve modulator offset correction in progress
choices.60: The pump is running after a heat demand. The remaining heat is put to the connected hydraulic system
choices.61: Remove the power from the pump
choices.95: The boiler is in wait state until the water pressure is sufficient. De-air will not start
choices.96: No producer available in the appliance or the system
choices.97: The minimum power is increased for 1 hour. Modulation range is limted.
choices.98: The maximum power is decreased as long as gas valve modulator is at the maximum limit. Modulation range is limted.
choices.105: The electronic combustion of the gas air is calibrating the combustion
choices.107: Compressor is in warmup time (ON, but not allowed to go OFF), that means compressor minimum on time
choices.108: Evaporator defrost protection active in curative mode, that means: remove ice from evaporator
choices.109: Evaporator defrost protection active in preventive mode, that means:  prevent ice formation
choices.254: The sub state of the boiler is undefined
choices.255: The safety core has been reset too many times in a row. Wait 1 hour or power cycle the device before a next reset can be given.
